title: Titan X Cherry Fizz Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Cherry Fizz is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, ensuring a smooth, hassle-free vaping experience. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to vape. The Cherry Fizz flavour blends the rich sweetness of ripe Cherry with a lively, sparkling tang for a vibrant vaping experience. Bright and juicy on the inhale with a subtly tangy, effervescent edge, this flavour delivers a satisfyingly layered mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape with a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable throat hit and rapid nicotine relief. With a pre-installed mesh coil for optimal flavour clarity and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit works seamlessly with the Titan X’s intelligent auto-refill system to offer up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
